bio: Excellent chicken croquettes, tripe with calf’s head boasting a wonderful spicy touch, a tasty special section dedicated to macaroni (just like mama used to make)... This cosy restaurant in the heart of the Sant Gervasi neighbourhood is run by experienced catering professionals and champions traditional Catalan cuisine that takes diners back to the flavours of home, reflecting a mother or grandmother’s cuisine, while not shying away from some modern touches in some dishes. Here, above all, humble and local cuisine can be rediscovered.
